samples.xml_description:
<module id="accu">
    <description>Accumulates four 8-bit inputs and outputs their sum. Valid output appears after receiving four inputs.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input data for addition.</input>
        <input id="valid_in">Signal indicating readiness for new input data.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Signal indicating when 4 input data accumulation is completed.</output>
        <output id="data_out" width_description="[9:0]">10-bit output data representing the accumulated sum.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ACCUMULATION_COUNT">Number of valid inputs required for accumulation.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <signal id="accumulation_counter" type="reg" width="integer">Counter to track the number of valid inputs received.</signal>
        <signal id="total_sum" type="reg" width="integer">Register to store the accumulated sum.</signal>
        <signal id="valid_out_reg" type="reg">Register to store the valid_out signal value.</signal>
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of clk or negative edge of rst_n
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                // Reset all registers and counter
                accumulation_counter <= 0;
                total_sum <= 0;
                valid_out_reg <= 0;
            end else if (valid_in == 1) begin
                // Increment the counter and accumulate the incoming data
                accumulation_counter <= accumulation_counter + 1;
                total_sum <= total_sum + data_in;
                
                // Check if the accumulation process is complete
                if (accumulation_counter >= ACCUMULATION_COUNT) begin
                    // Set the valid_out register to indicate completion
                    valid_out_reg <= 1;
                    
                    // Reset the counter and clear the accumulated sum
                    accumulation_counter <= 0;
                    total_sum <= 0;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Assigning output signals to corresponding registers
        assign valid_out = valid_out_reg;
        assign data_out = total_sum;
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Sequential logic to accumulate four 8-bit inputs and generate the output once all inputs have been received.</implementation>
</module>
